mapper.select: SELECT gt.name AS typeName, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ob.status IN (2, 3, 4) THEN od.price * od.shoppingnum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ob.status IN (2, 3, 4) THEN od.shoppingnum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalNum FROM goodstype gt LEFT JOIN goodstable g ON g.goodstype_id = gt.id LEFT JOIN orderdetail od ON od.goodstable_id = g.id LEFT JOIN orderbasestable ob ON ob.id = od.orderbase_id GROUP BY gt.id, gt.name ORDER BY gt.id ASC

SELECT g.name AS goodsName, g.price AS price, g.sales AS sales, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ob.status IN (2, 3, 4) THEN od.shoppingnum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalNum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ob.status IN (2, 3, 4) THEN od.price * od.shoppingnum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalAmount FROM goodstable g LEFT JOIN orderdetail od ON od.goodstable_id = g.id LEFT JOIN orderbasestable ob ON ob.id = od.orderbase_id WHERE g.isoff = 0 GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.price, g.sales ORDER BY g.sales DESC, totalNum DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ob.datetime, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(od.price * od.shoppingnum), 0) AS totalAmount, IFNULL(SUM(od.shoppingnum), 0) AS totalNum FROM orderbasestable ob INNER JOIN orderdetail od ON od.orderbase_id = ob.id WHERE ob.status IN (2, 3, 4) AND ob.datetime >= #{startMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ob.datetime, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
